title: Five in a row, together
intro: One board. Five proposals. One shared decision against white.
slotsHint: Select a slot to explore the board.
scope: Empty cells are ballot proposals. The team and machine move simultaneously when the ballot has votes.
boardHint: Claim a slot and choose a cell to submit your proposal to the team.
credentialHint: Use the sequence_bot API key assigned to the sequence. Credentials stay in memory only. The configuration password is a visual demo gate.
connectionError: Connection failed. Check the server and credentials.
assignmentError: This API key is not assigned to the sequence.
keyError: The specified sequence_bot API key is required.
serverError: Enter the HTTP/HTTPS backend origin without a path or credentials.
pinNotice: Your PIN is {pin}. Keep it safe; it will not be shown again.
chooseSlotOrBallot: Claim a slot and wait for an active ballot.
gameInactive: The game was paused due to inactivity.
suddenDeath: Sudden death: winning pieces are tied.
noVotesPause: No one voted. The game is paused and neither side moved.
noWinningVote: The team had no winning option; the machine still moved.
randomTieWinner: Tie: cell {cell} was selected at random.
adminIntro: Link existing surrogate accounts to the five slots in a sequence. To reserve a slot, set an alias and a four-digit PIN.
adminReservedPin: Four-digit PIN (required when reserving or changing)
adminLoginRequired: Sign in to manage game slots.
adminLoaded: Sequence loaded. Current PINs are hidden; leave the PIN blank to keep it unchanged.
adminFailed: The operation could not be completed.
exploreIntro: Choose an available What the Shell sequence to connect and play.
exploreEmpty: No games are available for this functionality.
exploreFreshOnly: This sequence has already started and cannot be recovered in this version.
gameRequiresFresh: This sequence already has turns; this version can only start fresh games.
connectGameError: Could not start the bot for this sequence.
GAME_BOT_CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED: Set WTS_BOT_API_KEY_ID and WTS_BOT_SECRET in multi-bot/.env, then restart the server.
INVALID_GAME_BOT_CREDENTIALS: The configured API key is invalid or is not an active sequence_bot.
